data.name: The Dinosaur League
data.detailed_description:
The Dinosaur League

The Dinosaur League is an open-world dinosaur survival adventure set in the Jurassic era.

Step into the role of a dinosaur and fight to survive on a mysterious island filled with dangerous predators, diverse ecosystems, and untamed wilderness. Grow, evolve, hunt, explore, and build your own story as you experience the life of a dinosaur from its earliest days.

🎮 Key Features

🦖 A True Survival Experience

There are no hand-holding tutorials or constant guidance telling you what to do.

You are on your own.

Manage your hunger, thirst, and stamina, learn how to survive in a dangerous ecosystem, and make your own decisions. Every encounter with another creature could be the difference between life and death.

🥚 Experience the Life of a Dinosaur

Start your journey as a young dinosaur and experience the complete life cycle of your species.

Hatch, grow, learn to hunt, socialize, reproduce, and eventually become a powerful adult dinosaur.

Every species comes with its own unique abilities, diet, strengths, weaknesses, and behaviors. Whether you are a fierce carnivore, a peaceful herbivore, or an adaptable omnivore, the way you survive is entirely up to you.

🌎 Explore a Living Open World

The island is a vast and unpredictable wilderness filled with diverse environments, including dense forests, open grasslands, mysterious swamps, towering mountains, and winding rivers.

Explore the island, discover hidden locations, search for resources, and uncover the secrets buried within its wilderness.

But nature isn't the only thing waiting for you.

Scattered across the island are the remains of human civilization, including abandoned facilities and mysterious ruins. Who built them? Why were they abandoned? And what happened to those who came before you?

The answers are waiting to be discovered.

👥 Survive Together or Against Each Other

The island is shared by many players.

Team up with other dinosaurs, hunt together, protect your territory, or compete for valuable resources.

Create your own team and purchase territory to establish a home base. Work together with your allies, expand your territory, and build your own presence on the island.

But remember: not every dinosaur you encounter will be a friend.

🧬 Grow, Evolve, and Become Stronger

Your journey doesn't end with survival.

Eat, drink, complete quests, explore the world, and gather resources to help your dinosaur grow stronger and develop new abilities.

As you progress, you can evolve your dinosaur and unlock more powerful forms and unique abilities, allowing you to adapt to the challenges of the island.

How you grow is up to you.

How long can you survive? How far can you evolve?

The island is waiting.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F, AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050, AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core Ultra 5 245K, AMD Ryzen 5 9600X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060, AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
